---
title: "bgm"
---

Bayesian estimation of graphical models for binary and/or ordinal variables.

## Description

`bgm()` fits a Bayesian graphical model using MCMC sampling. The model can 
handle ordinal variables (ordinal MRF) or continuous variables (Gaussian 
graphical model).

## Usage

```r
bgm(
 x,
 variable_type = "ordinal",
 reference_category,
 iter = 10000,
 burnin = 1000,
 ...
)
```

## Arguments
 
| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `x` | A data frame or matrix of observations. |
| `variable_type` | Character; `"ordinal"` (default) or `"continuous"`. |
| `reference_category` | Reference category for ordinal variables. |
| `iter` | Number of MCMC iterations after burnin. |
| `burnin` | Number of burnin iterations. |
| `...` | Additional arguments (see documentation). |

## Value

An object of class `bgms` containing:

- `interactions` — Posterior samples for edge weights
- `thresholds` — Posterior samples for threshold parameters  
- `gamma` — Edge inclusion indicators
- `prior` — Prior specification used

## Examples

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(bgms)
data(Wenchuan)

# Basic usage
fit <- bgm(Wenchuan)
summary(fit)

# With edge selection
fit <- bgm(Wenchuan, edge_selection = TRUE)
```
